label: An explicit three-world T chain is neither transitive nor symmetric
meaning: Issue #264 stipulated T-frame mathematics, not a source reading, refutation of Hume or Catholic-case frontier closure. Enumerate the reflexive chain. The missing root-to-endpoint and middle-to-root edges refute transitivity and symmetry. Atom negation distinguishes middle from endpoint, and negated possibility distinguishes root from middle. Compose these failures with domain restriction and enumerate accessible MC witnesses.
